blurb: Star Properties Destinations offers vacation rentals and property management services across the Florida Keys including Key Largo, Islamorada, Tavernier, Marathon, and the Lower Keys. They provide a variety of rental accommodations such as waterfront rentals, rentals with pools, and rentals with boat dockage. Their team is dedicated to customer service, cleanliness, and compliance with local and state regulations.
